comments.value:
I often use spreadsheets to manage the worlds I have visited by recording my impressions and tagging relevant attributes. 

Recently, I've been thinking about subscribing to VRC+. If I can list 4000 or more worlds, that would be the final push.

Tracked........July 14, 2023??????

When can I use it?

I NEED it.
I'd love to have more then just an increase to more world slots, but a better way to organize my worlds then just 4 folders too. It makes it hard to organize events or games
I know its not part of vrchat, but you can use companion tools like VRCX to have unlimited amount of favorite worlds. Similar to how people just been bookmarking them in their web browser for awhile.

I felt that 4 folders were insufficient for classifying world types.

 If worlds were categorized by season, worlds unaffected by seasons (e.g. locked rooms, unrealistic expression spaces, games) couldn't be included. Even worlds with similar themes should be categorized by purpose. If data bank space is an issue, I'd prefer they solve it by reducing the number of slots for favorite avatars.
asking DEVs to add more lines of codes VS browser bookmarking with unlimited Slots

VRCDevs: everyone want to increase avatar slots? <- official discord pull

Devs nobody want to increase world slots.
its finally happening <3 added 4 more slots in the beta today
This was implemented with four more rows (a total of +400 favorite worlds) in [VRChat 2026.1.1](https://docs.vrchat.com/docs/vrchat-202611). (cc: @{64873f159cf028090ce2c2e2|full_name})

details: We don't need more avatar slots, we need more world slots. Especially for those of us who like to explore.
title: More favorite world slots for VRC+
